notes: Per-asset metadata for the Utterbar marketing pack. Regenerated 2026-04-24 — tighter framing, smaller frames, no cinematic wash, all compositions render on --bg-0 so they seam into the site. `id` must match a Remotion composition id in src/Root.tsx.

videos.title: Floating bar — idle to inserted loop
videos.alt: Utterbar's floating bar cycling from idle through listening, processing, and 'Inserted'.

videos.title: Press. Speak. Done.
videos.alt: Close-framed loop of the pill moving from Ready to Inserted.

videos.title: Types wherever your cursor is
videos.alt: The pill above a plain text field; text streams into the field as the user dictates.

videos.title: Modes — one voice, three shapes
videos.alt: A raw transcript at the top; Voice-to-text, Message, and Meeting panels populate below it.

videos.title: 30+ languages, all on your PC
videos.alt: The Utterbar pill listening; a language chip cycles English, French, Japanese, Spanish; transcripts type out in each language into the same field.

videos.title: Transcribe what your PC is playing
videos.alt: Audio source selector switching from Microphone to System audio; live transcript fills below.

videos.title: Custom vocabulary + replacements
videos.alt: Custom words and replacements populate; a sentence types, rewrites itself with the replacements firing.

videos.title: Local by default
videos.alt: A 'Your PC' panel holds Audio, Transcripts, Vocabulary, History — connected by an internal cyan loop. A thin outbound line lights up briefly for each of four small network calls (update check, licence check, pricing, model download).
videos.placement: privacy page — primary visual; features page — local-privacy card

videos.title: Batch file transcription
videos.alt: Files dropzone with a queue of three jobs moving through queued, running, and done — then the user opens the finished transcript in a modal with Copy and Show in folder actions.
videos.placement: pricing page — Pro tier card; features page — file transcription card

videos.title: Talk to your AI assistant at the speed of speech
videos.alt: The Utterbar pill listening; a spoken question lands in a generic AI-chat input box and an assistant reply types back in.
videos.placement: features page — talk-to-AI card; home page — under the hero feature strip

videos.title: Reprocess any past dictation
videos.alt: A history entry's processed output re-runs through Meeting mode and rewrites into bullet points.

videos.title: Make the bar yours
videos.alt: A row of six accent swatches cycles, and the pill's LED + waveform change colour to match.
